summary: Iteration 52 - Retest of SnippetDestinationPicker initial-state fix (line 1222: useState(tradeOptions[0] || '__NEW__')) on real portal JXQ8EYEQ (Wheeler Ridge Residence) which has scope_of_work=[]. Fix is verified working end-to-end: modal opens with NEW TRADE input visible immediately, ADD LINE enables after typing DUMPSTER/GENERAL, POST fires with correct payload (parent_id=DUMPSTER::GENERAL), modal closes, DUMPSTER trade + GENERAL room banner appears in proposal, 2nd modal defaults to DUMPSTER/GENERAL (not __NEW__), shift-click bypasses modal and posts to last destination, X-delete does NOT open modal. All 2 created extras cleaned up; portal ends with extras=[].
critical_code_review_comments: The one-line fix at ProposalView.js:1222 (`useState(tradeOptions[0] || '__NEW__')`) correctly resolves the iteration_51 bug. When grouped=[] (proposal has no trades), trade state initializes to '__NEW__', so `isNewTrade` is true on mount → both snippet-new-trade-input and snippet-new-room-input render immediately. After typing values, ADD LINE button transitions from disabled→enabled as expected.

POST payload format verified correct: {parent_kind:'trade-room', parent_id:'DUMPSTER::GENERAL', name:<snippet name>, quantity, unit, cost, markup_percent, notes:''}. (Note: actual first card alphabetically is 'Cabinets - Hardware Install' not 'Demo - Dumpster (per haul)' as named in spec — but payload format and destination are exactly right.)

Second-modal default behavior: after adding to DUMPSTER/GENERAL, opening the modal again defaults trade='DUMPSTER' and room='GENERAL' (not __NEW__) — confirms the useEffect reset logic and useState fallback both work correctly when trades exist.
Shift-click bypass: POSTs directly to last destination DUMPSTER::GENERAL without opening modal — confirmed.
Delete X span uses e.stopPropagation correctly — clicking ✕ does not open the destination picker.
Cleanup verified: DELETE /api/builder/JXQ8EYEQ/proposal/extra/{id} returned successfully for both extras; final GET shows extras=[]. No pollution on user's real portal.
test_credentials: Builder Portal Access Code: JXQ8EYEQ (no login). proposal_view_enabled=true, proposal_edit_enabled=true.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 extras during the test (Cabinets - Hardware Install + Cleanup - Final (labor) via shift-click), both under parent DUMPSTER::GENERAL. Both DELETEd at end of test; verified GET /api/builder/JXQ8EYEQ/proposal returns extras=[].
